title: Not expensive, but surely you can do better
text:
Not expensive, but surely you can do better. Okay - so this isn't a top-of-the-line can opener.
In fact, some might wonder why anyone would bother to leave a review
at all for a can opener that is less than $25. Well I'll tell you why - you'll
save that money if you don't buy this one.

I didn't expect it to work by merely waving the can in the general area.
However, this can opener proved to be a real pain in the patootey.

It doesn't always like to hold on to the can, but once it does, good luck getting it
OFF the can opener. We had a lot of trouble with that on this model.
It was feast or famine, held the lid like glue or barely at all.
On the times it would hold tightly, it always made a mess on the counter to get the
can loose from the magnet.

Then a couple weeks ago, the little arm you see in the photo fell off completely.
It was laying on the counter. Both my husband (who is very handy) and myself tried to
get the little handle back on to stay, but nope - it was apparently afraid of heights
and preferred to lay safely on the countertop.

So, I tossed it into the trash last weekend.
We have a hand opener from Kuhn that I dearly love.
There are times when an automatic opener would be nice, like when your hands/wrists
are feeling particularly tired or sore, but it surely won't be this brand if/when we
get another one. Save your money and patience, and get something else.

product_metadata.title: Proctor Silex Power Electric Automatic Can Opener for Kitchen with Knife Sharpener, Twist-off Easy-Clean Lever, Cord Storage, White (75224PS)
features: Easily and Efficiently Opens Cans. Designed With Quality in Mind to Efficiently and Easily Open Many Different-Sized Cans, Without Being Complicated.
Twist-Off Cutting Lever: The Cutting Lever on the Automatic Can Opener Twists off to Make Cleaning Easy.
Built-In Knife Sharpener. Keep All Your Kitchen Knives Sharp Without Having to Buy a Separate Sharpening Tool.
Automatic Shutoff. This Hamilton Beach Can Opener Automatically Shuts off for Easy, Hands-Free Operation.
Cord Storage: The Cord Neatly Stores Inside the Can Opener to Reduce Countertop Clutter.
description: The Proctor Silex power opener can opener is designed with quality in mind to efficiently and easily Open many different-sized cans, without being complicated to save you time in the kitchen. Built-in features include a twist-off cutting lever for easy cleaning, A knife sharpener, and a cord storage area. This electric can opener is very easy to use and has a handy auto shutoff feature, which lets you open cans hands-free. The twist-off cutting lever makes this automatic can opener a breeze to clean. The built-in knife sharpener is located in the back of the opener to keep your kitchen knives their sharpest. When you're not using the electric can opener, The cord neatly pushes into a storage area at the base of the opener to keep your countertop clutter-free.

Tall enough to open a 7-inch-high can, this electric can opener is as practical as it is stylish. It has a knife sharpener in the rear as well as push-in cord storage, allowing for tidiness on the counter. The cutting lever removes for easy cleanup. Clad in gleaming white plastic, the opener measures 8-7/8 inches high, 4-1/4 inches wide at the base, and 3-1/2 inches deep. When operating, a magnet flips down and grips the top of the can, then lifts it off when the can is removed.
